messages:
maria_pm: Quick sync — HW partners asked for a single 'ambassador' handshake process so press + marketplace + SI can agree on a single date. Proposed: two windows: partner beta (limited access) and public GA. Thoughts?

raj_partnerships: Love the handshake idea. We need to lock driver/kernel/firmware minimums first. Nvidia H200/H100 have different driver requirements vs. Gaudi/MI300.

kyle_hw: From HW side: target driver bundles: H100 -> driver 55.8+, H200 -> 56.1+, MI300 -> ROCm 6.6+, Gaudi -> NeuronX 2.3+. SI test image coming next week.

adin_engineer: Can we make a compatibility matrix? I'll drop a quick matrix we can use with partners.

maria_pm: please share matrix + a short runbook we can give partners (1 pager).

adin_engineer: paste matrix:

```
HW | min_driver | kernel | marketplace SKU | smoke-test
H100 | 55.8 | 5.19 | h100-standard | infer-microbench + kv_cache
H200 | 56.1 | 6.1 | h200-lowlat | infer-microbench + mixed-batch
MI300 | ROCm 6.6 | 6.1 | mi300-highth | fp16/amp perf + mem-bw
Gaudi | NeuronX 2.3 | 5.15 | gaudi-optimized | gpipe/compaction test
```

maria_pm: Perfect. Add "announcement gating" checklist too.

sloane_eng: Proposed gating checklist:
- marketplace SKU published and tested
- partner legal comms signoff (Mkt + PR)
- SI integration completed smoke tests
- deployment runbook + rollback steps
- embargo window scheduled

raj_partnerships: Add: capacity reservation for first 2 weeks + support on-call roster.

deploy-bot: CI: marketplace-image/build #124 completed — digest sha256:abcd1234efgh... :white_check_mark:

maria_pm: timeline proposal: Week A (partner beta) -> Week B (public GA). Need partner signoff by EOD Fri of Week A-1.

kyle_hw: Vendors indicated Gaudi inventory risk ~+1 week. We'll flag early.

maria_pm: OK—I'll draft the one-pager and send to partners tomorrow. Raj, can you own legal & PR handshake?

raj_partnerships: yes, I'll loop in legal and PR. tagging @legal-team @press

sloane_eng: I'll prep runbook + run the smoke tests once the SI image lands.

maria_pm: thanks all. If no blockers, we aim to announce partner beta next Wed. :tada:
